criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Sharing Information
categories.definition: Utterances expressing a desire to share COVID-19 related information or reports.

categories.name: Expressing Gratitude
categories.definition: Utterances expressing thanks for COVID-19 related information or assistance received.

categories.name: Seeking Information on Transmission
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on how COVID-19 transmits, including from pets to humans.

categories.name: Seeking Latest Updates
categories.definition: Utterances seeking the latest updates or news on COVID-19.

categories.name: Seeking Cure Information
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on the availability of a cure for COVID-19.

categories.name: Seeking Donation Information
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on how to donate to COVID-19 relief efforts.

categories.name: Seeking Specific Country Updates
categories.definition: Utterances seeking COVID-19 related news or updates specific to a country.

categories.name: Seeking Data or Statistics
categories.definition: Utterances seeking the latest data or statistics related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Seeking Information on Symptoms
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on COVID-19 symptoms.

categories.name: Seeking Information on Prevention
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on how to prevent COVID-19.

categories.name: Seeking Information on Myths
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on debunked myths or misinformation about COVID-19.

categories.name: Seeking Travel Advice
categories.definition: Utterances seeking advice on travel during the COVID-19 pandemic.

categories.name: Expressing Concern for Pets
categories.definition: Utterances expressing concern for pets and seeking information on protecting them from COVID-19.

categories.name: Seeking Information on High-Risk Areas
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on travel restrictions and high-risk areas for COVID-19.

categories.name: Seeking Information on Cleaning and Disinfection
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on cleaning and disinfection methods for COVID-19 prevention.

categories.name: Seeking Information on Testing
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on COVID-19 testing, including for animals.

categories.name: Expressing Frustration or Helplessness
categories.definition: Utterances expressing frustration or helplessness about the COVID-19 situation.

categories.name: Seeking Information on Vaccine
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on the availability of a vaccine for COVID-19.

categories.name: Seeking Information on Treatment
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on treatment options for COVID-19.

categories.name: Seeking Information on Recovery Rate
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on the recovery rate of COVID-19 patients.

categories.name: Seeking Information on CDC Recommendations
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on recommendations from the CDC for COVID-19 prevention and treatment.
